purpose: Preserve raw exact-number internet hits separately from P1/P2 evidence so collision frequency, source-class frequency, no-hit outcomes, and null-model behavior remain auditable.

policy.rule: A raw hit records occurrence only. It carries zero automatic physical-evidence weight.
policy.promotion: Promotion to P1/P2 requires an independently verified physical quantity and, for P2, a documented same-system physical relation.
policy.no_hit: Defined searches that return no relevant exact occurrence are retained as no-hit observations rather than discarded.
policy.worldshepherd_use: Every substantive publication surfaced through a raw hit is separately routed for engineering, characterization, security, data-analysis, or negative-control use.
